page.overview:
Who is G. Oriber?

Oriber is a bald obese man, appearing nearly identical to Bill Bull in his appearance in Final Fight. He has a black beard, and wears blue pants with suspenders and a white button-up shirt, along with blue armbands on either arm.

In his Street Fighter V artwork, he now wears blue overalls with one of the straps undone, and a white sleeveless undershirt underneath. He no longer wears armbands, and sports a pair of green gloves.

Oriber is stated to be extremely confident, believing himself to have the strongest leg power out of the three members of the "Headbutt Corps". He takes great pride in his sideburns, preferring to shave with a straight razor rather than an electric one.

Graham appears as a common enemy in Final Fight, working as a member of the Mad Gear Gang under Belger in his plot to retain control over Metro City. He confronts Haggar, Cody, and Guy during their attempt to rescue Haggar's daughter, Jessica, from the clutches of the Mad Gear Gang.
